$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0. Owner ruling R1 (2026-11-13) and the owner answers on hypatia#1080 (2026-11-14). Read at compile time by Hypatia.TriangleRouter.ownership_cap/1. A recipe listed here is capped at report_only whatever its confidence, so Bayesian updating cannot raise it back to auto_execute. Recipes not listed (groups E and F) keep their confidence-based tier.

squabbler_owned.description: cicd-squabbler is the first-line fixer for these categories (ADR 0003). Hypatia reports the finding and refers it; it runs no parallel fix.

flag_only.description: Estate cap: licence and SPDX findings are flagged for a person and never auto-fixed, by Hypatia or by a referral.
